large_customers_reason: Guests are mostly individual travelers and group or transient business guests, not mainly large enterprises.

people_delivered_reason: Customers pay mainly for the software platform and automation, not for staff time.
large_customers_reason: Focus is small and mid-sized businesses, from local boutiques to franchises, rather than large enterprises.
asset_heavy_reason: Cloud software business that needs development and staff, not plants, fleets or properties.

asset_heavy_reason: Operates hundreds of large vehicle storage yards worldwide, needing continual land purchases and yard expansion, plus tow and handling equipment.
notes: Buyers include dealers, dismantlers, exporters and some public individuals; sellers are mainly insurers. Revenue is mostly auction service fees.

offers_products_reason: Sells prescription OUD medicines: Suboxone film, Sublocade (buprenorphine extended-release injection) and related buprenorphine products.

people_delivered_reason: Value is in patented pharmaceutical products, not staff time; a drug maker.

large_customers_reason: Customers are recruiters and employers of all sizes plus staffing firms; large contractors like Lockheed are only some of them.
